usage_note: All entities and observations are fictional. .example domains are reserved for examples. This dataset is for development and demos, not real-world accusations.

scenarios.name: Connected promotional network
scenarios.description: Fictional accounts share a domain, payment reference and duplicated promotional content.

scenarios.name: Consistent legitimate-style business
scenarios.description: Fictional shop and support accounts have consistent business links and no strong adverse evidence in this dataset.

scenarios.name: Possible brand impersonation
scenarios.description: A fictional account resembles a fictional reference brand and requires human verification.

scenarios.name: Insufficient evidence
scenarios.description: Fictional personal accounts have too little evidence for a reliable conclusion.

evidence.description: Five fictional promotional/support accounts reference the same synthetic domain.
evidence.interpretation: A shared domain is a lead for investigation, not proof of wrongdoing.

evidence.description: Two fictional promotional posts share the same synthetic content hash.
evidence.interpretation: Matching content may indicate reuse or coordination; context is required.

evidence.description: Three fictional accounts reference the same synthetic payment identifier.
evidence.interpretation: A shared identifier is a connection signal, not a verdict by itself.

evidence.description: Several connected demo accounts were created within a short period.
evidence.interpretation: Account age is contextual and not evidence of fraud on its own.

evidence.description: Fictional shop and support profiles use consistent business identity and domain.
evidence.interpretation: Consistency is reassuring only within this synthetic dataset.

evidence.description: The fictional clearance profile resembles the fictional Nordvale reference brand.
evidence.interpretation: Similarity warrants review but does not establish impersonation.

evidence.description: The fictional clearance profile uses a different domain from the reference brand.
evidence.interpretation: Different domains can warrant review; legitimate campaigns can use separate domains.

evidence.description: Available synthetic records do not establish a meaningful adverse connection.
evidence.interpretation: Insufficient evidence does not mean an account is guaranteed safe.

rules: Never label an account fraudulent from one signal alone.
Reports are unverified unless independently supported.
Every finding shown to a user must link to supporting evidence.
Evidence confidence is not a probability of guilt.
Human review is required before external action.
